title: Closing a Spherical Triangle
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: trureturing cyberpunk · three integer rays on a violet sphere, the spherical triangle in cyan and its magenta area, a Gram matrix and a 4 × 3 matrix of minors, one great circle with equal steps, a face-on circle of doubled arcs, four triads side by side on a 0 to 1 meter
summary: Three integer quaternion rays a = 1, b = 1 + i, c = 1 + j: one side alone has the irrational cosine 1/√2, which flips sign when a becomes −a, but the Bargmann loop number B = ⟨a,b⟩⟨b,c⟩⟨c,a⟩/(|a|²|b|²|c|²) meets every vertex twice and is 1/4, unchanged (computed). The raw Gram matrix has determinant 1, and over the squared lengths 4 the closing number det G₃ = 1 + 2B − (κ(a,b) + κ(b,c) + κ(c,a)) is 1/4; Lean checks this exact value for the half-step triad. For the equal-sided triad 1 + i, 1 + j, 1 + k the four 3 × 3 minors 1, −1, 1, 1 square-sum to 4, so det G₃ = 4/8 = 1/2 (computed; the Cauchy–Binet identity is the chapter's written derivation), and Lean checks that det G₃ is never negative for any three nonzero integer quaternions. On one great circle, a = 1, b = 2 + i, c = b ā b = 3 + 4i give κ = 4/5, 4/5, 9/25, B = 12/25 and det G₃ = 0; with b = 1 + 2i, B = −3/25 keeps a sign the sides forget (computed); Lean checks that every doubling triad closes to zero and that the doubled overlap is (2κ − 1)², shown on 4/5 → 9/25, 9/10 → 16/25, 1/2 → 0 (computed). Vertex spreads of the half-step triad are 1, 2/3, 2/3, above the flat 1/2 (computed); Lean checks the rational sine law (all ratios 4/3 here) and the right-angle law (1/4 = 1/2 · 1/2). A gallery of four triads reads 0, 1/4, 1/2 (vertex spreads 8/9 against the flat 3/4) and 1 (computed); that 1 is the largest value and that classical trigonometry is the one-way real shadow det G₃ = sin²α sin²β sin²C are the chapter's argued remarks.
summary_zh: 三条整四元数射线 a = 1、b = 1 + i、c = 1 + j：单看一条边，余弦是无理数 1/√2，而且把 a 换成 −a 时会变号；巴格曼环路数 B = ⟨a,b⟩⟨b,c⟩⟨c,a⟩/(|a|²|b|²|c|²) 让每个顶点出现两次，等于 1/4 且不变（屏幕计算）。原始格拉姆矩阵的行列式是 1，除以模方之积 4，闭合数 det G₃ = 1 + 2B − (κ(a,b) + κ(b,c) + κ(c,a)) = 1/4；Lean 检验正交半步三元组的这一精确值。等边三元组 1 + i、1 + j、1 + k 的四个三阶子式 1、−1、1、1 平方和为 4，故 det G₃ = 4/8 = 1/2（屏幕计算；柯西—比内恒等式为本章书面推导），Lean 检验任意三枚非零整四元数的 det G₃ 都不为负。在同一大圆上，a = 1、b = 2 + i、c = b ā b = 3 + 4i 给出 κ = 4/5、4/5、9/25，B = 12/25，det G₃ = 0；取 b = 1 + 2i，B = −3/25，环路保住了边丢掉的符号（屏幕计算）；Lean 检验每组倍增三元组都闭合于零，且倍增后的重叠为 (2κ − 1)²，片中以 4/5 → 9/25、9/10 → 16/25、1/2 → 0 演示（屏幕计算）。正交半步三元组的顶点展开度为 1、2/3、2/3，大于平面上的 1/2（屏幕计算）；Lean 检验有理正弦律（此处比值都是 4/3）与直角律（1/4 = 1/2 · 1/2）。最后四组三元组并列读出 0、1/4、1/2（顶点展开度 8/9，平面为 3/4）与 1（屏幕计算）；1 为最大值，以及古典三角学是单向实数影子 det G₃ = sin²α sin²β sin²C，均为本章的论证性评注。
